title: Crispy Tofu With Cashews and Blistered Snap Peas
description: Crispy pan-seared tofu coated in a rich coconut-ginger sauce with cashews, served alongside blistered snap peas tossed with herbs and vinegar.

steps.instruction: Slice tofu in half horizontally and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season tofu with salt and pepper and sear until golden on both sides, about 8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon oil to the pan and cook snap peas until blistered and tender, about 3 minutes. Season with salt and set aside.
Heat remaining oil and cook ginger and garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add coconut milk, soy sauce, and molasses. Simmer until reduced and thickened, about 6–8 minutes.
Stir in cashews. Break tofu into pieces and add to the sauce, tossing to coat.
Toss snap peas with rice vinegar, scallions, mint, and red pepper flakes.
Serve tofu and snap peas over rice or grains.
